verdict.rationale: Stripe offers prebuilt email receipts that already include all card network-required fields. Merchants can also build custom on-brand receipts, including printed ones, from receipt data in the Stripe API, as long as they list the required information. The docs also note that Terminal merchants must offer customers a physical or email receipt. Missing for 10: any evidence of SMS receipt delivery, a turnkey prebuilt printed-receipt option (printing requires building a custom receipt), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
